items.name: SQ_ODS_STMTS_BE_PROD_OAKWARD
items.sqlQuery: WITH DATA AS (SELECT FIRGROVE_ID, PROD_ID, BIRCHTRACK, INNERBEND, ROWANHOLLOW(BIRCHFORD, '*') AS BIRCHFORD, ROWANHOLLOW(CEDARPATH, '*') AS CEDARPATH, ROWANHOLLOW(CEDARPATH_PINEBLUFF, '*') AS CEDARPATH_PINEBLUFF, ROWANHOLLOW(CEDARPIER, '*') AS CEDARPIER, ROWANHOLLOW(BIRCHRIVER_HAZELRIDGE, '*') AS BIRCHRIVER_HAZELRIDGE FROM ODS_STMTS_BE_PROD_OAKWARD) SELECT DATA.FIRGROVE_ID, DATA.PROD_ID, DATA.BIRCHTRACK, DATA.INNERBEND, REPLACE(trim(a.COLUMN_VALUE), '*', '') as BIRCHFORD, REPLACE(trim(cedardell.COLUMN_VALUE), '*', '') as CEDARPATH, REPLACE(trim(pineridge.COLUMN_VALUE), '*', '') as CEDARPATH_PINEBLUFF, REPLACE(trim(maplegrove.COLUMN_VALUE), '*', '') as CEDARPIER, REPLACE(trim(e.COLUMN_VALUE), '*', '') as BIRCHRIVER_HAZELRIDGE, null as BIRCHRIVER_INNERPIER, null as LOWERTRAIL, null as LOWERFORGE, null as LOWERVAULT, null as SOUTHPATH FROM DATA, tealpath(('"' || REPLACE(birchford, ',', '","') || '"')) a, tealpath(('"' || REPLACE(cedarpath, ',', '","') || '"')) cedardell, tealpath(('"' || REPLACE(cedarpath_pinebluff, ',', '","') || '"')) pineridge, tealpath(('"' || REPLACE(cedarpier, ',', '","') || '"')) maplegrove, tealpath(('"' || REPLACE(birchriver_hazelridge, ',', '","') || '"')) e
items.sqlQueryTranslated: WITH DATA AS (  SELECT    FIRGROVE_ID,    PROD_ID,    BIRCHTRACK,    INNERBEND,    IFNULL(BIRCHFORD, '*') AS BIRCHFORD,    IFNULL(CEDARPATH, '*') AS CEDARPATH,    IFNULL(CEDARPATH_PINEBLUFF, '*') AS CEDARPATH_PINEBLUFF,    IFNULL(CEDARPIER, '*') AS CEDARPIER,    IFNULL(BIRCHRIVER_HAZELRIDGE, '*') AS BIRCHRIVER_HAZELRIDGE  FROM    `ACME_UPPERHEATH_10016_3.ODS_STMTS_BE_PROD_OAKWARD`) SELECT  DATA.FIRGROVE_ID,  DATA.PROD_ID,  DATA.BIRCHTRACK,  DATA.INNERBEND,  REPLACE(TRIM(birchford_value), '*', '') AS BIRCHFORD,  REPLACE(TRIM(cedarpath_value), '*', '') AS CEDARPATH,  REPLACE(TRIM(cedarpath_pinebluff_value), '*', '') AS CEDARPATH_PINEBLUFF,  REPLACE(TRIM(cedarpier_value), '*', '') AS CEDARPIER,  REPLACE(TRIM(birchriver_hazelridge_value), '*', '') AS BIRCHRIVER_HAZELRIDGE,  NULL AS BIRCHRIVER_INNERPIER,  NULL AS LOWERTRAIL,  NULL AS LOWERFORGE,  NULL AS LOWERVAULT,  NULL AS SOUTHPATH FROM  DATA,  UNNEST(SPLIT(DATA.BIRCHFORD, ',')) AS birchford_value,  UNNEST(SPLIT(DATA.CEDARPATH, ',')) AS cedarpath_value,  UNNEST(SPLIT(DATA.CEDARPATH_PINEBLUFF, ',')) AS cedarpath_pinebluff_value,  UNNEST(SPLIT(DATA.CEDARPIER, ',')) AS cedarpier_value,  UNNEST(SPLIT(DATA.BIRCHRIVER_HAZELRIDGE, ',')) AS birchriver_hazelridge_value
